title: Little Girl on Bench Studio Portrait, 1940 Fort Smith Sepia Photo
back_text_transcription:
BARNETT CAMERA SHOP
705 GARRISON - FORT SMITH, ARK.
MAR 1940

42
description: A studio portrait of a young girl with blunt bangs and a hair bow, seated politely on an upholstered floral bench. She wears a collared pleated dress with cuffed short sleeves, thick rolled socks, and white lace-up shoes, posed against a painted studio backdrop resembling a large paned window. The back bears a circular stamp from Barnett Camera Shop located at 705 Garrison in Fort Smith, Arkansas, dated March 1940.
